decision: Accepted full research specification of38 active cards within explicitly source-bound limited results; sufficient basis for subsequent implementation of this concrete scope.
allowed: All211 unchanged source numerical parameters, boundaries/units/intervals and identified form constraints.
Typed input contracts/unknown/source identity, own A/B phase/currentdose provenance and separate MAOI clocks.
Finite bounded known exclusion/choice/form/action/conditional source-reference and explicitly nonselected example contracts with exact necessary facts.
Honest reported context and every supplied positive/negative/unknown count; no free other allergy actor/hidden MAOI type/date/phase.
Russian source gaps and published ranges/options, with no source-free next step, combined coefficient, default rounding or foreign fallback.
excluded: Automatic universal Russian pair/taper protocol where source supports only individual components/reference/gap.
Clinical deployment or patient-specific clinical clearance from this research acceptance.
Unsupported combination coefficient, arbitrary range choice, rounding or IR/XR/form substitution.
Automatic inference of negative facts, drug current-use phase, organ classification or interaction class from absent/unknown input.
required_future_implementation: Actually execute normal/boundary/unknown/unit/form/actor/source-clock/conditional-stage and cause-dependent dialogue checks in a future implementation; prepared expected are not application tests.
